newCases.name: callback detail binds notes and status to the revision and audit read before a concurrent edit
callback detail cannot combine an earlier revision with a deleted conversation and later audit
callback list holds one snapshot across a safety hold while fresh task mutations remain blocked
callback detail keeps STOP flags with their saved revision and rejects contact mutations after STOP
callback list keeps later records in the same snapshot after the first record is materialized
callback detail and list read failures release owned snapshots without writes or stale later reads
callback reads leave a caller read snapshot open across later deletion and missing-record errors
callback business export retains its outer snapshot through nested request reads and a concurrent hold

accounting.explanation: The eight new callback methods and preceding seven panel methods are included in 275. The focused 15-case run overlaps and is not added again.
accounting.excludedDevelopmentRun: An initial test fixture omitted the required status on a mutation. Corrected before the final unchanged-file baseline; that harness error is not a product failure or goal credit.

defect.readBoundary: Request row(s), suppression/contact state, messages and audit were materialized through separate autocommit queries.
reproducedOutcomes: Earlier status and note values/revision with the later update audit.
Earlier revision with an empty conversation and deletion audit from the next revision.
Safety hold and STOP commits mixing request revision/values with later contact or audit state.
A list mixing earlier saved records with later metadata for another record.
defect.fix: Share one deferred readSnapshot helper across getLead, listLeads and getPanelProject. Start and finish only an owned transaction; preserve caller read/write/export transactions.

mutationControls: A stale task or status mutation still rejects version_conflict.
A current-revision callback task after a safety hold rejects safety_review_required.
Current-revision task and contact status mutations after STOP reject contact_blocked.
Other-owner requests with the same phone remain unchanged and inaccessible through the current actor.
remainingLimits: Complete integrated-source regression and committed-source CI remain required.
A coherent read may become stale after it returns; it is not authorization for later contact or mutation.
No filesystem pathname, Windows native storage, selected-host durability or real customer acceptance is established.

peerReview.result: No concrete defect found in complete-read coverage, caller transaction ownership, contact restrictions or coordinated native SQLite tests.
